entry.focal: Three 1.6 m stone lanterns (lights3 gauntlet) plus g_east:lights0:0, which fills the right third of the frame 1.4 m from the lens. The hero is a dim brown slab half hidden behind the lanterns.
entry.next_visible: Weakly: rail-post lanterns on the far right. The cliff-path mouth (NE) is out of frame, and there is no sea or surf: the horizon is a flat black plane.

reveal.focal: The lens itself, but it reads as an unlit brown 6x6 m stage 0.6 m high. Two lantern blocks at the frame edges are the brightest things.
reveal.next_visible: Rail posts along the east edge only. No sea, no surf, no cape lantern.

concept.focal: A field of about ten evenly spread white lantern blocks. The lens is a sliver behind them.
concept.next_visible: None. Plan 31's red tree, cliff rail with lanterns and white surf are all missing at eye height.

strip.focal: The exit_tree box on the left and the lights0 lanterns. Frame 0 is fully black (camera inside the door geometry). Frames 6-7 look into the black slot of g_east_path with a few lanterns at the end.
strip.next_visible: Yes, the lantern line of the cliff path ahead, but it reads as a corridor between walls, not a cliff edge.

fixes.detail: Make it a lens flush with the paving: h 0.6 -> 0.08 (top at z 0.05), with an emissive lava-orange top face and a 3-4 m translucent steam column marker above it. As a raised brown plinth it reads as a stage or table and gives no light.

oculus_glow sits at z -1.0 under a solid 0.6 m slab, so none of its light gets out. Raise it to z -0.1 just under the glass and make it about 3x the lantern_stone output, so the hero is the brightest thing on the terrace.

The 'both' sides 1.6 m lantern_stone rows along branch to_oculus put 5 tall glowing blocks across the middle of the terrace. They form a gauntlet that hides the lens from the door. Change to side 'left' only (east side of the branch), asset lantern_niche or a 0.5 m ground lantern, spacing [4,7], offset 1.2. Then the lights lead to the lens without blocking it.

It sits 1.4 m from the entry camera and fills a third of the entry frame. The door is already lit by lights3:0. If the lead wants to keep it, move it by (+4.0, +1.5) so it lands beside the spine instead of in the first sightline.

The posts on the cliff rail are almost evenly spaced (44.4/53.3/60.8/67.8). Use spacing [5,12], cluster two posts at the lookout bench (y 44-48), and leave y 49-58 dark so the lens wins in the reveal. Separately, make sure railing segments render: none of the dressing[0], [1] or [4] rails appear in any frame.

top_change: Turn the hero into a flush, emissive orange lens with its glow actually escaping, and clear the 1.6 m lantern gauntlet between the door and the lens, so the first thing you see on stepping out is an orange glow on a dark terrace.
plausibility: Hero is a 0.6 m raised slab, but the intent is a glass lens 'in the paving'. Walking over it would mean stepping up 0.6 m.
oculus_glow at z -1.0 is buried under the opaque hero box.

Railings (dressing[0], [1], [4], at z 1.05 with status 'structural') are invisible in every render. Either they are not rendered or they float at z 1.05 above the paving. The cliff edge currently reads as unguarded.
dressing[4] ring rail is missing indices 6-10 (the whole east half of the ring). If that is the access gap it is too wide; a 1.5-3 m gate is enough.
No sea plane or surf beyond the east and south rails: the terrace ends in a black horizon.
